references.text: The Israelites defeated the Midianites in battle, leading to their humiliation and defeat.
The land had rest for forty years after Othniel delivered Israel, the same period as after Gideon's victory.
Moab was humbled under Israel's hand, and the land had rest for eighty years, with similar phrasing about peace and the humiliation of enemies.
The land had rest for forty years after Deborah and Barak's victory, the same period of peace as after Gideon's victory.
The psalm mentions Midian as an example of God's enemies who were defeated, referring to this historical event.
Isaiah refers to 'the day of Midian' as an example of God's mighty deliverance of His people.
The Lord will lift up his staff over the sea as he did against Midian at the rock of Oreb, a direct reference to Gideon's victory.
